subject: german
title: Umwelt und Okologie
welcome_lead: Sharing the Planet centres on environment. Germany's Energiewende leads the climate debate.

concepts.def: Energy transition — Germany's shift to renewables.

walkthroughs.body_html: Germany's commitment to phase out nuclear (Atomausstieg) and shift to renewables. Bis 2030 sollen 80% erneuerbar sein.
Ich trenne Mull, fahre Fahrrad, vermeide Plastik. Use modal verbs: man sollte, man musste.
Pariser Klimaabkommen (2015). Gemass dem Abkommen muss die Erwarmung unter 2 Grad bleiben.

mcqs.q: Which words are capitalised in German?
options: All nouns (and the first word of a sentence).
Only the first word of a sentence.
Only proper nouns, as in English.

mcqs.q: When does 'in' take the accusative vs dative?
options: Accusative for movement INTO a place; dative for location IN a place.
It depends on the speaker's mood.
It always takes the same case.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I watch TV every evening' in German?
options: It depends on the speaker's mood.
